correctness.rationale: For the 31 exact antipodal lines, the addition theorem reduces rank to the 31-by-31 Legendre Gram matrix. In Q(sqrt5) the even and diagonally-congruent odd matrices have exact entries. Standalone verification reconstructs directions, checks exact rank 0..74, supplies 1625 nonzero modular determinant witnesses for 75..1699 with p=10009 and sqrt5=4070, and checks the strict algebraic spacing plus Bernstein diagonal-dominance bound for all k>=1700. Hence all infinite quantifiers are established rather than inferred from tests. Limitations: no independent mathematical audit.

value.rationale: Thirty-one icosahedral rotation axes are a canonical complete projective arrangement. Determining the rank at every exact harmonic degree is a natural full interpolation classification not recoverable by adding the two separate-orbit rank tables: evaluation-map intersections are unknown from each marginal rank. The result has nonmonotonic rank with first full at k=29 and final deficiency at 74, yielding the sharp universal permanent threshold 75. This is an exact, structurally motivated natural invariant with reproducible infinite-degree certificate; no downstream generalization is required.
